question: What does a boundary-stratified PopClip Extension corpus reveal about behavior Spinnet must support, degrade, or reject, and which runtime features materially affect the Plugin process boundary?
selection_method: Purposive maximum-variation sample across all six configuration containers observed in the pinned official repository and across static, invocation-script, common-JavaScript, and extended-JavaScript behavior. This is not a random sample and cannot support an ecosystem-wide compatibility percentage.

upstream.licence_basis: The repository README states that all source code is MIT-licensed. No package-level licence override was found in the selected package README/Readme files. The committed snapshot preserves the upstream MIT notice and excludes artwork, demos, and documentation.

input_snapshot.scope: Behavior-relevant configuration and executable text files explicitly listed for each sampled PopClip Extension; artwork, demos, and documentation are excluded.

compatibility_levels.name: Host Adapter
compatibility_levels.meaning: Declarative behavior can map to Host Commands without starting a Plugin process.

compatibility_levels.name: Invocation Script
compatibility_levels.meaning: Shell Script or AppleScript behavior requires a short-lived interpreter, capability checks, timeout, and result adaptation.

compatibility_levels.name: Common JavaScript
compatibility_levels.boundary: Shared JavaScript runtime facility with a logical context per Plugin
compatibility_levels.meaning: JavaScript uses common input, context, options, and popclip bridge calls but still requires a sandboxed bridge and semantic validation.

compatibility_levels.name: Extended JavaScript Review
compatibility_levels.meaning: Networking, authentication, retained state, external dependencies, DOM/HTML processing, uncommon APIs, or dynamic behavior needs explicit design and review.

reject_outcome.name: Reject
reject_outcome.meaning: Unknown configuration, native executable content, or an unclassified executable surface is rejected rather than treated as a Compatibility Level.

extensions.name: DuckDuckGo
extensions.reason: Legacy declarative URL action with a selection regex.

extensions.name: Delete
extensions.reason: Host-adaptable key press with requirements and stay-visible semantics.

extensions.name: Say
extensions.reason: Invocation-only shell process with environment-derived options.

extensions.name: Alfred
extensions.reason: Invocation-only AppleScript embedded in a declarative container.

extensions.name: Antinote
extensions.reason: One of the two AppleScript configuration containers in the pinned snapshot.

extensions.name: AlternatingCase
extensions.reason: Pure transform plus options and popclip.pasteText.

extensions.name: Base64
extensions.reason: Static JSON manifest delegates to JavaScript and uncommon util helpers.

extensions.name: Agenda
extensions.reason: TypeScript module reads browser context, captures rich text, and calls popclip.openUrl.

extensions.name: Bitly
extensions.reason: Network entitlement, authentication flow, bundled code, and external dependencies.

extensions.name: Ollama
extensions.reason: Network access, external dependency, modifier input, and state retained between invocations.

extensions.name: CopyAsMarkdown
extensions.reason: Captured HTML, DOM construction, and two external JavaScript dependencies.
